name: Semfirms
requirements: B2B service providers / agencies only - SEO, PPC, digital marketing, web design/development, IT services; NOT a product/SaaS directory
Register a user account at /add-user/ (email + generated password) then create a free profile
Listings are editorially vetted: SEMfirms 'carries out an in-depth research' and an analysis before listing a firm
The catalog's listed submit URL (/submit-a-listing) is 404; real entry points are Register (/add-user/) and Apply For Sponsorship
preparation: Agency details: name, website, location, service categories (very long taxonomy from SEO to Shopify development)
Client reviews/portfolio evidence - verified client reviews are part of the value prop
For sponsored tier: budget and chosen service categories/countries
workflow: Register at https://www.semfirms.com/add-user/ (enter email, generate password)
Create a free profile for the agency from the account dashboard
Optionally apply for 'Verified Sponsored Listing' via /apply-for-sponsorship for priority placement
Free members can also post blogs, jobs, photos, and videos from the dashboard at no charge
watchFor: Do not submit a SaaS product - this directory lists service firms/agencies only
The catalog's submission URL is dead; use the Register flow instead
Sponsorship tiers control ranking placement; organic rankings are 'based on client reviews'
A paid 'Verified Listing Registration' path exists at /paiduser
countsAsLive: The agency has a public profile page on semfirms.com reachable from its country/service listing pages, with reviews enabled.
unknowns: Exact free-profile form fields after registration
Verification criteria and turnaround for the free profile
